Manage cloud and network infrastructure using Terraform and infrastructure-as-code best practices. Deploy, configure, and optimise SD-WAN, SSE, and SASE technologies across global locations. Administer and maintain firewalls, VPNs, switching, routing, DNS, load balancing, and application delivery services. Develop network observability capabilities using metrics, logs, flow data, synthetic monitoring, and intelligent alerting. Lead network incident response, including troubleshooting, service restoration, stakeholder communication, root cause analysis, and preventative measures. Design and test resilient network services, including redundancy, failover, disaster recovery, and capacity planning. Plan and implement controlled network changes, maintaining accurate configurations, architecture diagrams, procedures, and audit trails. Automate network operations and configuration validation using APIs, Python, PowerShell, and other relevant tools. Working knowledge of SSE/SASE and zero-trust security platforms, such as Netskope, Zscaler, or Prisma Access. Experience with AWS and/or Azure networking, including VPCs, VNets, transit gateways, peering, and VPN connectivity. Knowledge of network security controls and compliance frameworks, including ISO 27001, NIST, and CIS. Experience supporting business-critical or 24/7 operational environments with defined availability and service-level objectives. Familiarity with network monitoring, observability, logging, and alerting tools such as Grafana, AWS CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, NetFlow, or equivalent platforms. Experience working with telecommunications providers, cloud vendors, and managed service partners. Strong communication, documentation, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills. Global collaboration: Work with distributed technology teams across multiple international locations. Modern technologies: Develop your expertise across cloud networking, infrastructure-as-code, SD-WAN, SASE, and network security. Continuous improvement: Influence automation, observability, resilience, and operational best practices. Business-critical impact: Help ensure the availability, performance, and security of systems that support essential business operations. If you’re an experienced Network Engineer looking for a role where you can combine hands-on technical delivery with infrastructure development, security, and automation, apply ASAP for a quick turnaround on your application.
